data.explanation: This is an invoice from Schornsteintechnik Beispielruß GmbH for renovating your chimney on 16–17 November 2026. The total amount due is €1,785.60, to be paid by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from the invoice date). Pay by bank transfer to the IBAN given, quoting the invoice number SR-26-0914 as reference. Since this is craftsman labour (Handwerkerleistungen), keep this invoice and your bank transfer receipt — such costs can reduce your income tax under §35a EStG when you file your tax return, but only if paid by transfer, not cash.
